factCards.text: Fearless won Album of the Year at the 52nd Grammy Awards in January 2010; Swift was twenty, the youngest winner of that award to that point.

factCards.text: folklore and evermore both appeared in 2020 with only days of notice, and both credit Aaron Dessner of The National as a principal collaborator.
The Eras Tour opened in Glendale, Arizona in March 2023. Trading handmade beaded bracelets became the tour's best-known audience custom.
